sn22.29:1.2: “Bhikkhus, one who seeks delight in form seeks delight in suffering.
sn22.29:1.3: One who seeks delight in suffering, I say, is not freed from suffering.
sn22.29:1.4: One who seeks delight in feeling …
sn22.29:1.7: in consciousness seeks delight in suffering.
sn22.29:1.8: One who seeks delight in suffering, I say, is not freed from suffering.
sn22.29:1.9: “One who does not seek delight in form …
sn22.29:1.14: in consciousness does not seek delight in suffering.
sn22.29:1.15: One who does not seek delight in suffering, I say, is freed from suffering.”
